verdict.rationale:
Docs explicitly describe custom ranking, rules to override relevance (e.g., for promotions), Merchandising Studio for curating/pinning/boosting, Personalization for user-level ranking affinity, and Recommend for popularity/trending signals—directly covering business-signal-based relevance beyond text match. Community feedback corroborates heavy use of custom ranking/rules in production, though some complain relevance still needs tuning for edge queries, which is a general quality caveat rather than a contradiction of the capability itself.
missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark showing recency/margin-based ranking specifically working well, and no explicit mention of 'margin' as a ranking field example.
